ModMetaData.name: Medieval Overhaul - Recycle Only 1.5 v1.5
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: Adds recycling only to Medieval Overhaul's existing mending bench. Reuses MO's WorkGiver, JobDriver, effects and repair-tool fuel path, but intercepts recycle completion so the item is dismantled into materials instead of being repaired to full. Recycle work mirrors MO mending at 30 work per remaining HP.
